$comment: Small team as operations by key (document 21, section 6.5). Overlays apply after the full preset's wildcards expand.
A tier 3 proposer may approve their own decision only with an accepted exception decision on record (document 28, Q10).
The change manager also decides exceptions about a change, so no change board is needed. Tier 3 changes and emergencies already go to the change manager in Balanced (document 28, Q11).
deployer-not-sole-approver stays at flag. It is stated here on purpose, so the overlay's level does not depend on the full preset under it.
